conditions: Deliver 5 offerings, kill 30 Infested per squad member (up to 120), drop the Oni to half HP, deliver 2 more offerings, then finish the Oni. The mission can't be shortened, only run faster.
The table is shared with 11 other Koumei, Higasa and Amanata parts, so most clears reward something else.
Run normal mode, not Steel Path: the Oni's damage attenuation there roughly doubles clear time for only a few extra Pearls.
bonuses: Stockpile offerings during the Exterminate phase and deliver both the moment the half-HP window opens; a second basket is carriable after The War Within.
Crowd control at both offering huts (Vauban, Khora, Mirage) keeps the delivery timer running; Nova, Volt or Wisp speed helps the runners.
Public matchmaking is busy since Koumei is early-game, so other players often do the deliveries for you.

disclosures.title: the zero-luck ceiling
disclosures.body: The blueprint, two Blades and the Handle cost 270 Pearls bought outright, then crafting consumes another 47. At normal rewards that is roughly 20 runs total.

conditions: Spend only on the blueprints still missing once you have enough Pearls for all of them, so a later drop doesn't waste a purchase.
